title: Transport of ordinary pullback to global-section modules
statement: For every scheme X there exist a point-evaluation equivalence e, an additive functor P from Γ(X,O_X)-modules to O_X-modules with the prescribed inverse-image and change-of-rings object and morphism equations, a strong monoidal structure on P, and an adjunction P ⊣ Γ(X,-) satisfying the concrete section tensor/counit normalization. The notions and formula are those of def-pc-global-derived-rhom, lem-pc-ringed-space-tensor-pullback-underived, lem-sc-module-cup-naive-map-chain and lem-sc-global-tensor-pullback-monoidal-normalization. No derived tensor or left derived functor is asserted.

source.place: global point specialization; Tags 008A/008Y and monoidal normalization

proof.text: Let G be evaluation on the global sections point. The point-module evaluation theorem makes G an equivalence e. Take the ordinary concrete pullback T with its object and map equations, additivity, and adjunction to moduleDirectImage p. Define P=e.inverse ⋙ T. Its object/map equations are the equations for T evaluated at e.inverse; additivity follows because an equivalence preserves binary products. Compose e.symm.toAdjunction with the pullback adjunction and transport its right side along the natural isomorphism moduleDirectImage p ⋙ e.functor ≅ Γ(X,-), whose component is the identity linear map since p-sharp is the identity. Apply the monoidal normalization theorem to this P and adjunction. Package the resulting data.

theorem exists_globalTensorPullback_underived_data :
    ∃ (e : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (globalSectionsPoint X)) ≌
        ModuleCat.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op ⊤)))
      (_ : Nonempty (e.functor ≅ RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor (globalSectionsPoint X)))
      (P : ModuleCat.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op ⊤)) ⥤
        SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
      (h : ∀ M, P.obj M = SheafOfModules.changeOfRings.{u, u, u}
        (CochainComplex.tensorPullbackRingMap (toGlobalSectionsPoint X).hom.base
          X.toRingedSpace.sheaf (globalSectionsPoint X).sheaf
            ⟨(toGlobalSectionsPoint X).hom.c⟩)
        (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageModule (toGlobalSectionsPoint X).hom.base
          (globalSectionsPoint X).sheaf (e.inverse.obj M)))
      (_ : ∀ {M N} (a : M ⟶ N), P.map a = eqToHom (h M) ≫
        SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsHom.{u, u, u}
          (CochainComplex.tensorPullbackRingMap (toGlobalSectionsPoint X).hom.base
            X.toRingedSpace.sheaf (globalSectionsPoint X).sheaf
              ⟨(toGlobalSectionsPoint X).hom.c⟩)
          (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageModule (toGlobalSectionsPoint X).hom.base
            (globalSectionsPoint X).sheaf (e.inverse.obj M))
          (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageModuleMap (toGlobalSectionsPoint X).hom.base
            (globalSectionsPoint X).sheaf (e.inverse.obj M) (e.inverse.map a)) ≫
          eqToHom (h N).symm)
      (hadd : P.Additive) (mon : P.Monoidal)
      (adj : P ⊣ RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace),
      letI := hadd
      letI := mon
      letI := adj.isLeftAdjoint
      ∀ M N : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace),
        Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ P
            ((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).obj M)
            ((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).obj N) ≫
          P.map (moduleCup_sectionTensorMap X M N) ≫ adj.counit.app (M ⊗ N) =
        adj.counit.app M ⊗ₘ adj.counit.app N
